note: The page states that on 2 January 1985 the Ministry of Communications was renamed the Ministry of Communications and Information.
The page states that on 28 November 1990 the Ministry of Communications and Information was renamed the Ministry of Communications.
The page states that on 3 June 1999 the Ministry of Communications was expanded and renamed the Ministry of Communications & Information Technology.
The page states that on 23 November 2001 the Ministry of Communications & Information Technology was renamed the Ministry of Transport.
The press release states that the Ministry of Trade and Industry will be renamed the Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry with effect from 1 October 2026.
